messages.en:
{07 14 00}I just got{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points
from the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I guess the directions my
stuff faced had really good
feng shui.
{07 00 00}I don't know what feng shui
is,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00} but apparently I have it
coming out my ears!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sain just{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemialt{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Vist oli mu asjade suund
tõeliselt hea feng shui.

{07 00 00}Ma ei tea, mis feng shui on,
{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00} aga seda paistab mul

messages.en:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It feels really good to have
all your furniture from the
same series.
{07 16 00}What?{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, don't
look at me like that{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. I'm
not weird.
{07 0d 00}The {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}agrees! They gave me
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} points!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}On väga hea tunne, kui kogu
mööbel on ühest sarjast.

{07 16 00}Mida?{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ära vaata
mind niimoodi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Ma pole

{07 0d 00}{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemia
{ff 00 00 00}nõustub! Nad andsid mulle
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} punkti!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yesterday{01 00 00 0a 00} the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00} sent out their
evaluations.
{07 00 00}I earned {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} points! I
think it's 'cause I collect
similar-looking furniture.
{07 0a 00}I guess it's good that I
just happened to collect
similar stuff,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Eile{01 00 00 0a 00} saatis {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu

{07 0a 00}Vist on hea, et ma juhtusin
koguma just sarnaseid asju,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Guess what?! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00}I got
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points from the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 00 00}It must be because I
collect only a particular
style of furniture.
{07 19 00}All the Academy cares about{01 00 00 05 00}
is coordinating things like
that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}{07 00 00}
messages.et:
Tead mis?! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00}Sain
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemialt{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 00 00}Küllap sellepärast, et ma
kogun ainult ühte kindlat
mööblistiili.
{07 19 00}Akadeemiat huvitabki ainult{01 00 00 05 00}
asjade kokkusobivus,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So,{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} just who exactly are
the judges at the {ff 00 00 02}Happy
Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Are they really objective,
or is the {ff 00 00 02}furniture {ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}that
really boosts your score
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}just their own favorite
kind of furniture,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii,{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} kes täpselt on
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} hindajad?
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kas nad on ikka ausad
või on see {ff 00 00 02}mööbel {ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}mis
su punkte tõstab
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}lihtsalt nende endi
lemmikmööbel,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
According to the letter I
got from the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 0f 00}{01 00 00 14 00}...my room's a mess! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00}I can't
believe that coordination
earned me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I guess cutting-edge style
always takes a while to
catch on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
I know I'm being judged, but
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 03 00}I can't help but laugh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Like
a maniac! {01 00 00 0a 00}A huh huh huh!
messages.et:

sain {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemialt{ff 00 00 00}...

Tean, et mind hinnatakse,
aga {01 00 00 05 00}{07 03 00}ma ei saa naeru pidama!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Nagu hull! {01 00 00 0a 00}Ah hah hah haa!
